author: Eric Skovan
text:
I did it a couple of times when I first started using them, really easy, no questions asked. 

Well, actually, when you call they do ask some questions. They also ask you to send back the whole kit, including the applicator and the thing the sensor comes mounted in.

Ever since then I always put these parts back in the box and don’t throw them away until I throw the sensor itself away..

author: Ken Brown
text: It definitely works. I have had to do it a few times. Very helpful and they send a replacement
